action 'Compiling lto/main.c'
  Mnemonic: CppCompile
  Target: //lto:bin
  Configuration: k8-opt
  Execution platform: @platforms//host:host
  ActionKey: e3b047e2349831c7c6b23bbf3b937fab4ea007115086ae2245e7cdbdff92b014
  Inputs: [bazel-out/k8-opt/bin/lto/fdo/cc_tc/profile.afdo, lto/lib.h, lto/main.c]
  Outputs: [bazel-out/k8-opt/bin/lto/_objs/bin/main.pic.d, bazel-out/k8-opt/bin/lto/_objs/bin/main.pic.indexing.o, bazel-out/k8-opt/bin/lto/_objs/bin/main.pic.o]
  Environment: [PATH=/bin:/usr/bin:/usr/local/bin]
  Command Line: (exec /usr/bin/gcc \
    -MD \
    -MF \
    bazel-out/k8-opt/bin/lto/_objs/bin/main.pic.d \
    '-frandom-seed=bazel-out/k8-opt/bin/lto/_objs/bin/main.pic.o' \
    -fPIC \
    '-DBUILD_FDO_TYPE="AFDO"' \
    -iquote \
    . \
    -iquote \
    bazel-out/k8-opt/bin \
    -iquote \
    external/rules_cc+ \
    -iquote \
    bazel-out/k8-opt/bin/external/rules_cc+ \
    -iquote \
    external/bazel_tools \
    -iquote \
    bazel-out/k8-opt/bin/external/bazel_tools \
    '-flto=thin' \
    'lto_indexing_bitcode=bazel-out/k8-opt/bin/lto/_objs/bin/main.pic.indexing.o' \
    '-fauto-profile=bazel-out/k8-opt/bin/lto/fdo/cc_tc/profile.afdo' \
    -c \
    lto/main.c \
    -o \
    bazel-out/k8-opt/bin/lto/_objs/bin/main.pic.o)
# Configuration: 76bf0a873969ad92a11cf7b6d783634648cd9e87931f266facf43a9e3a76f521
# Execution platform: @@platforms//host:host
